inputs.text: Photorealistic production 3D game-asset render of one exact bi-directional combat vehicle, Unreal Engine 5 quality, clean three-quarter side presentation. Image right: sleek aerodynamic silver interceptor nose with a low front air dam, recessed twin 25 mm machine guns, functional vents and flush armored headlights. Image left: rugged dark metallic armored command-van nose with a steel brush guard, heavy-duty suspension, radiator grille and riveted armor plates. Center: one seamless shared dual-drivetrain cabin and chassis joining both functional front ends. Exactly three visible wheel positions along this side, all wheels attached at their hubs with realistic tire sidewalls, tread, alloy rims, brake discs and axles; no embedded or floating wheels. Hard-surface mechanical greebling, crisp panel gaps, hinges, fasteners, grilles, exhaust heat shielding and believable PBR metal/rubber/glass materials. Neutral studio backdrop, controlled high-contrast product lighting, entire vehicle visible, sharp silhouette, physically plausible engineering, production automotive proportions.
